comment: The ./server entry's JavaScript alone, for a server's image (D58): it emits without checking types, so it needs none of the packages the TypeScript engine's declarations reach (schema-runtime, schema-ir, superscalar, the version graph), which no module ./server loads imports. verbatimModuleSyntax keeps every import as the source writes it, so the emitted modules are the checked build's. The package's own build checks them.
